intelligence.human_view: Think of Settings as the front door of a house. You open it and you see the whole house listed by name — who you are first, then notifications, then your cover buttons, then the common things — and you walk into the room you want. The first room is you: who you are, one small question at a time, one frame, tap next, next, next, until you're done — never a long form staring at you all at once. Every button in that house is a real object, black and raised, lighting up in its own colour when you touch it, and the colours move through the whole house like a rainbow as your hand moves. Your mail is not a row in a list — it is a real letter, framed, raised, beautiful, like a manuscript you could hold. Your chat lives in a frame that grows with the talk, down and down until the whole conversation fits inside. And when someone has read your message, you don't see a cold little checkmark — you see their face. The words are big enough to read without leaning in, and a voice note plays at your speed. And the colours down the side of the house run in their true order — no colour twice in a row, none skipped — purple and magenta both kept, both at their most beautiful, because they are neighbours, never twins.
intelligence.simple_view: Settings opens on YOU first! It asks who you are, one small question at a time. Each question gets its own little frame, and you tap next, next, next! Every button is a shiny black jewel that lights up in its own colour. Your mail is a real letter in a pretty frame. And your chat frame grows and grows until the whole talk fits inside! Magenta stays magenta, purple stays purple, and both stay beautiful.
intelligence.grandma_view: It's like this, love — Settings is the front door of the house, dear, and when you open it you see every room listed by name, love, and the very first room is YOU! One small question at a time, dear, one pretty frame, tap next, next, next, until you're done — never a long form staring at you all at once! Every button is a lovely black jewel, love, that lights up in its own colour when you touch it! And your mail, dear, is a real letter in a beautiful frame — not a row in a list, a letter you could hold! Your chat grows with the talk, love, down and down until the whole conversation fits inside! And when someone reads your message, dear, you see their sweet face — not a cold little tick!
intelligence.naya_view: Settings is a menu of areas — Set Your World first, Notifications, Cover Buttons, Common Settings — each its own area reached from Settings, nothing crammed into All Settings. Set Your World: one question per frame, multiple choice, next until answered; flow harvested from the walkthrough. Spectrum through Settings: each block turns a new colour on hover, never one colour per section. Menu entries are obsidian buttons lighting their own colour, raised high-level icons like the Hub sidebars, long enough to scroll; entries include install-app-on-page + public on/off. THE FRAME IS THE STANDARD — every pop-up and feature display, frame by frame, the zoomed-in viewpoint. Messenger: EXPANDABLE frame, scroll down and the frame goes down until completed; seen = reader's face orb; labels 17px; voice notes 1.5×/2×. Mail: a framed letter — extraordinary, high contrast, raised boards, text like the intelligent boards; study the elite, then do it 10× better. Sidebar flow: the settled spectrum sequence, no repeat back-to-back, no skip — Dashboard and Hub aligned, one set, same on every page. Keep both magenta and purple — most beautiful rich versions, high contrast; Dashboard anchors on points purple, Hub stays magenta.
